newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Banking consortium to finance Dutch power plant.
newsitem.headline: Banking consortium to finance Dutch power plant.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank and ING Bank said on Wednesday they had arranged an 820 million guilder financing for a power plant in the southwestern Netherlands on behalf of an international banking consortium.
The combined heat and electricity plant is being constructed at the production site of chemicals firm Dow Benelux and is due to become operational in the third quarter of 1997.

Partners in the project are Destec Energy Inc, which is 72.6 percent owned by Dow Chemical Co, Dow Benelux and two local Dutch energy producers. The plant will be the largest non-state-owned energy plant in the Netherlands.
